## /rebar-debug final report — LANDED

**Problem.** A late LLM-Review result for a NON-current patchset dispatched Gerrit Verified for
that stale revision; because Verified concurrency is keyed by Change-Id with cancel-in-progress,
the stale run cancelled the CURRENT patchset's in-flight Verified run (observed on change 2225:
stale-PS5 review published 03:43:46Z cancelled the active PS6 run 32926871119).

**Proven root cause (TOCTOU / preexisting omission).** `voter._review_and_vote` cast the
`LLM-Review` vote (`post_review` -> `gc.post_vote`) at the END of the 15–45 min review with no
re-check that the reviewed revision was still current. `app._worker`'s daa7 guard
(`_superseded_by`) runs ONCE, only BEFORE the review starts, so a patchset superseded DURING the
review was still voted on; that vote's Gerrit comment triggers g2p's `recheck=verify` substring
mapping (`infra/gerrit/gerrit_to_platform.ini.template`) -> dispatches `gerrit-verify.yaml` for
the stale refspec -> Change-Id-keyed `cancel-in-progress` cancels the current run.

**Proof.** Held-out RED oracle `tests/unit/test_review_bot_stale_vote_baa8.py` drove the real
`voter.review_and_vote` with current-revision `rev2` != reviewed `rev1`: on `main` the voter
STILL cast the vote on stale `rev1` (RED). Three fail-open controls + a still-current control
passed, discriminating the contract. Mutation-checked: defeating the guard re-reddens the oracle.

**Defect origin.** PREEXISTING — introduced with the voter itself, story `cogent-strut-kid`
(918c-589a-fc4a-4c52), commit `1d1a072a` (2026-06-29). The voter has voted without a pre-cast
currency re-check since inception. Date test confirms: baa8 evidence 03:33Z predates daa7's
guard landing 10:47Z the same day — daa7 later closed only the pre-review window and strictly
improved matters, so it is a related partial mitigation, not the origin. Closed
`--class=preexisting --caused-by=918c-589a-fc4a-4c52`.

**Legitimacy = defect (behavior-restoring), not a new policy.** The fix RESTORES cited standing
intent — daa7's guard docstring names "VOTING ON a superseded patchset" as the harm; ADR-0009
(bot votes on the current revision); ADR-0020 (a stale/copied CI signal must never carry onto
code CI never ran). No change to Verified concurrency semantics or gate/vote precedence, so no
ESCALATE was warranted.

**Fix.** `src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py` — a pre-vote current-revision re-check
(`_superseded_before_vote`) immediately before `post_review`: re-reads the change's current
revision via `gc.get_change_event` (off-loop), and if it differs from the reviewed revision,
SUPPRESSES the vote (no `post_review`, no dedup write), emits a `voter_skip` diagnostic
(event/current revision, event type, `disposition=vote_suppressed_superseded`), and returns
`{"status":"skipped","reason":"superseded"}`. FAILS OPEN on any lookup failure (None / exception
/ unusable revision); `force`/`manual-rerun` bypass (current-by-construction). ~15 non-test lines,
under the 150-line bugfix-size floor. A behavior-preserving extraction kept the C901 score at 15.

**Scope & safety.** Single vote chokepoint; restoration not new behavior; no new dependency; no
test weakened. `make lint`, `make typecheck`, the full `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py` suite
(90 passed), and CI (`Verified +1`, incl. the changed-shard mutation gate) all green.

**Siblings.** `_review_and_vote` is the ONLY vote-casting site; the webhook worker, the reconcile
backfill (`reconcile.py:362`, calls without `force`), and the manual `/rerun` endpoint all funnel
through it, so the single guard covers every dispatch surface. Reconcile is now protected too;
manual rerun is force/current-by-construction (intended bypass). No sibling defect.

**Advisory (non-blocking, from LLM-Review).** The `manual-rerun` event-type bypass branch lacks
a dedicated test (the `force=True` control exercises the same early-return). Non-blocking; a
reasonable follow-up hardening.

**Replication.** RED oracle on `main` (vote cast on stale rev) -> GREEN after fix; mutation check
(guard defeat -> RED returns) -> restored.

**DISPOSITION: LANDED afe01efaa8b2c685b5a44d527e1219e9d7a0ce59** (Gerrit change 2330, merged;
LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1). Ticket closed `--class=preexisting --caused-by=918c-589a-fc4a-4c52`.
